title: FREEMAX MESH PRO REPLACEMENT COILS 3PCS
description:
FreeMax Mesh Pro Replacement Coils are the only way to keep your FreeMax tanks running at the top of their game.
As an early innovator in the world of sub-ohm coil technology, FreeMax produces some of the highest quality mesh coils on the market. Find the right style for your device to ensure maximum lifespan and proper function.
Each pack contains three replacement coils.
FreeMax Mesh Pro Replacement Coils Features & Specifications:
0.15ohm Kanthal Sextuple Mesh Coil : 80 – 140W
0.15ohm Kanthal Quintuple Mesh Coil : 80 – 130W
0.15ohm Kanthal Quad Mesh Coil : 80 – 120W
0.15ohm Kanthal Single Mesh Coil : 40 – 70W
0.2ohm Kanthal Double Mesh Coil : 60 – 90W
0.15ohm Kanthal Triple Mesh Coil : 80 – 110W
0.25ohm Kanthal DVC Coil : 50-100W
0.12ohm SS316L Single Mesh Coil : 400 – 550F
